flow.name: api-main
flow.doc:description: Exposes the Check-In API over HTTPS at /api/* and routes requests to the implemented operations.

http:listener.doc:description: Receives HTTPS Check-In API requests at /api/* using the shared listener configuration.

http:response.doc:description: Returns the APIkit status code and outbound headers on successful responses.

http:error-response.doc:description: Returns APIkit error payloads with the status code stored in httpStatus.

apikit:router.doc:description: Validates requests against the Check-In API spec and dispatches them to the matching flow.

error-handler.doc:description: Applies the shared api-global-error-handler to errors raised by APIkit routing.

flow.name: api-console
flow.doc:description: Serves the APIkit console at /console/* for exploring the Check-In API.

http:listener.doc:description: Receives HTTPS requests for the APIkit console at /console/*.

http:response.doc:description: Returns console responses with the APIkit status code and outbound headers.

http:error-response.doc:description: Returns console error payloads with the status code stored in httpStatus.

apikit:console.doc:description: Renders the APIkit console generated from the Check-In API specification.

error-handler.doc:description: Handles APIkit console errors with a JSON message and a 404 status.

on-error-propagate.doc:description: Catches APIKIT:NOT_FOUND in the console and propagates a JSON 404 response.

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Message
ee:transform.doc:description: Builds the JSON body and httpStatus variable for console resource-not-found errors.

ee:message.doc:description: Defines the JSON payload returned for console 404 errors.

ee:set-payload.doc:description: Sets a JSON body with a Resource not found message.

ee:variables.doc:description: Sets the HTTP status variable for the console error response.

ee:set-variable.doc:description: Sets httpStatus to 404 for the console error response.
